  NOTICE AND CALL OF SPECIAL MEETING OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL
  (Government Code Section 54956)

  TO THE MEMBERS OF THE INGLEWOOD CITY COUNCIL
NOTICE IS HEREBY ORDERED by the Mayor that a special meeting of the City Council will be held
on Wednesday, February 2, 2022, at 11:00 a.m., in the Council Chambers, One Manchester Boulevard,
Inglewood, California (Government Code Section 54956)
  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****
  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS
Due to the existing COVID-19 health emergency and the social distancing measures currently in effect, and
pursuant to Assembly Bill 361, please note that members of the public will be allowed only to observe and address
the City Council Meeting of Wednesday, February 2, 2022, at 11:00 a.m. by telephone, video and other
electronic means, as follows:

  1. Written Public Comments: Members of the public may choose to submit comments electronically for
  consideration by the Inglewood City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/Finance
  Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers Authority (Legislative Body) by sending them to the City
  Clerk/Secretary at athompson@cityofinglewood.org, and Deputy City Clerk at aallen@cityofinglewood.org.
  To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to consideration of the agenda, City Clerk
  staff will check and print emails prior to arriving in the Council Chambers. In the body of the email, please
  identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the meeting date and agenda
  item. Comments received will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of

Inglewood, California
  February 2, 2022

  The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting on Tuesday,
  February 2, 2022, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into session at the hour of 11:01 a.m.

  The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts;
  and
  Absent: None.

  City officials and personnel present were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk
  Artie Fields  City Manager
  Ken Campos  City Attorney
  Louis Atwell  Assistant City Manager/Public Works Director
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Mayor Butts inquired if there were any persons present who
  wished to address the City Council on any item on the Agenda.

  There was no response.

178  AGREEMENT NO. 22-136 APPROVED – INGLEWOOD UNIFIED SCHOOL
  DISTRICT (IUSD); CHIEF OF POLICE (OR DESIGNEE) AUTHORIZED – TO
  APPROVE SIMILAR, NO-COST AGREEMENTS. Staff report dated February 2,
  2022, was presented recommending approval of an agreement with the Inglewood
  Unified School District (IUSD) for use of school facilities at Caroline Coleman Stadium.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby: 1) Approve Agreement No. 22-136; and 2) Approve
  ongoing authorization for the Chief of Police (or designee) to approve similar, no-cost
  agreements. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

178  AGREEMENT NO. 22-137 APPROVED – INGLEWOOD UNIFIED SCHOOL
  DISTRICT (IUSD). Staff report dated February 2, 2022, was presented recommending
  approval of an agreement with the Inglewood Unified School District (IUSD) for use of
  school facilities at Morningside High School.

  It was moved by Council Member Morales, and seconded by Council Member Faulk that
  the City Council does hereby approve Agreement No. 22-137. The motion was carried by
  the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  There being no further business to be presented, Mayor Butts adjourned the meeting at
  the hour of 11:03 a.m.

  Approved this 1st day of March, 2022.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, City Clerk
  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Mayor
